description: Contains the implementation of the PageBreakRenderer class responsible for rendering page breaks within the MigraDoc PDF rendering library. The class handles formatting and layout logic specific to page breaks during document rendering.

classes.name: PageBreakRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a page break to a graphics context, managing its formatting and layout.

methods.name: PageBreakRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a graphics context, a page break object, and optional field information.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Prepares the layout info for rendering the page break within a specified area, setting properties like PageBreakBefore.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the page break; currently does nothing.

methods.name: InitialLayoutInfo
methods.description: Provides initial layout information indicating a page break before the current content.
